palette: deep pine-ink green, verdigris bronze, rice-paper cream, cinnabar seal red, amber lamp gold, indigo slate, graphite ink
typography: registry ledger headings on verdigris plate badges, brush-stroke condition lines and cinnabar wax verdicts
composition: a civic registry hall where a life-timeline gate, a three-tier age bench, will-fork benches, dual order ladders and a duty verdict wall stand in sequence
surface: aged rice-paper ledgers, verdigris bronze plates, cinnabar hand seals, amber lamp light
motion: life tickets travel the birth-death gate, capacity tiers rise like stair treads, guardian pacts fly between benches and settle as sealed verdicts
transition: the registry floor, lamp rail and bronze plate frames persist while benches and ladders are re-dressed between scenes
